issues.detail: The skill is specific to Node.js and does not support other runtime environments.

scenarios.name: create-s4-business-partner
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully meets the rubric by using OAuth and CSRF tokens, posting the correct JSON payload, and extracting the BusinessPartner ID, whereas Response A uses Basic auth, incorrect fields, and omits the required steps.

scenarios.name: scaffold-bookstore-cap-service

scenarios.name: shopify-to-s4-webhook
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required express.raw middleware, HMAC verification, and a sapApi call with the correct payload structure, though it omits the final 200 response; Response B lacks the express.raw middleware, uses a different payload format, and does not call sapApi with the specified endpoint, so it falls short of the rubric.
